items.title: FORSAKEN CITIES
items.text:
0 FORSAKEN CITIES
• Become immediately infested.
• Only the Drive/Ferry action is permitted.
• Put Infection cards for forsaken cities into the Game End area and draw replacement cards.
• Do not count toward Game End Production.
• Cost 2 to increase to a population of 1.

rules: A forsaken city is population 0, shown as a white 0 in a red square.
Only the Drive/Ferry action is permitted.
Put Infection cards for forsaken cities into the Game End area and draw replacement cards.
Do not count toward Game End Production.
The 2 is printed in a yellow circle. It costs 2 production units to increase to a population of 1.
mechanics.effect: Forsaken cities are immediately infested, allow only Drive/Ferry, send their Infection cards to Game End, and produce nothing at Game End. Restoring one to population 1 costs 2 production units.

items.title: Area 12 placement
items.text: Put this sticker on the game board onto Area 12.

mechanics.effect: Place the Forsaken Cities sticker on Area 12 of the game board.

summary: Forsaken Cities rule sticker for Area 12. Population 0, immediately infested, Drive/Ferry only, Infection cards go to Game End, no Game End production, and 2 production units restore it to population 1.
